subject.title: CI: report circular dependencies in PRs

question: Should circular-dependency reporting live as a separate dependency-cruiser PR-summary lane, or should it be rebuilt on current main's existing import-cycle guard infrastructure?
rationale: The submitted direction is useful but now overlaps current main's cycle guards and changes CI runner, dependency, lockfile, and rendered-summary surfaces, so automation cannot choose the permanent CI/tooling shape alone.

options.title: Rework on existing guards
options.body: Use the current `scripts/lib/import-cycle-graph.ts` path for report generation where possible, then fix the lockfile and workflow/report hardening before merge.

options.title: Approve a separate depcruise lane
options.body: Keep dependency-cruiser only if a maintainer accepts the extra root dependency and the PR adds capacity proof plus security hardening.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: If current main's guards are sufficient, close or replace this stale branch rather than carrying the duplicate CI lane forward.

recommendation.title: Rework on existing guards
recommendation.body: Use the current `scripts/lib/import-cycle-graph.ts` path for report generation where possible, then fix the lockfile and workflow/report hardening before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current import-cycle guard and is best positioned to decide whether a separate dependency-cruiser report lane is still needed.
